command:
printf 'NETWORK ADDRESSES
'
ip -4 -o addr
printf '
WLAN PROFILE
'
nmcli --colors no -f GENERAL.STATE,GENERAL.CONNECTION,IP4.ADDRESS,IP4.GATEWAY device show wlan0
nmcli --colors no -f connection.id,connection.interface-name,connection.autoconnect,ipv4.route-metric connection show qb560d-training-wlan
printf '
SSH SERVICE
'
systemctl is-active ssh sshd 2>&1
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -lntp | grep -E ':22 |:5555 ' || :; else /opt/qb560d-workshop/bin/ss -lntp | grep -E ':22 |:5555 ' || :; fi
for exe in /usr/sbin/sshd /sbin/sshd; do
  [ -x "$exe" ] || continue
  "$exe" -T | grep -E '^(permitrootlogin|passwordauthentication|listenaddress|port) '
  break
done
printf '
SSH PUBLIC HOST KEYS
'
for entry in /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub; do
  [ -r "$entry" ] || continue
  cat "$entry"
done
